decisions.reason: The modular plant concept already shows a strong quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros a year, so its value is beginning to show and the option is worth keeping open at low cost within an established modular strategy.
This slow-speed shredder sits close to the firm's core offer and has its own page, so keeping it costs little and it supports the established business with parts and service revenue.
As a multi-model flagship line central to the firm's modular direction, its uncertainty is still resolving and continued commitment is justified rather than abandonment after only one year.
The trommel screen is a low-cost extension of a core product category in a growing industry, so there is no evidence that would justify dropping this option.
